    • setQuadRects

      public boolean setQuadRects(RectF[] quadRects)
      Uses the rects property to set the areas that should be covered by the redaction annotation. The page coordinate system has its origin at the left-bottom corner of the page, with the X-axis on the bottom going to the right, and the Y-axis on the left side going up. The device coordinate system is device dependent. For screen device, its origin is at the left-top corner of the window.
      Parameters:
      quadRects - Array of quadrilateral points defining the bounds of the Redaction.
      Returns:
      Returns whether to successfully set the array of quadrilateral points defining the bounds of the redaction.

    • eraseInfoRedaction

      public boolean eraseInfoRedaction()
      Removes the page content inside this redaction's areas and deletes the annotation. The removed content cannot be recovered; the marked areas are left without the overlay appearance. The core performs the same text and object removal as applyRedaction(), differing only in that existing path objects inside the areas are not cleared. Reload the text page before reading text afterwards.
      Returns:
      Returns whether the content was removed successfully.
